chain.text: Domaine des Trois Chênes farms 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc) on clay/flint, averaging 62,000 bottles; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail cut western plots by a fifth. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, certification earliest 2026. Exports are 41% (Belgium, Japan); Japan requires sulphites under 60mg/L. Two failures: a 2022 tank 4 controller drift cost €11,000 (now calibrated, second probe added); a 2023 label error recalled 900 bottles (proofs need two signatures). Rules: no western irrigation, harvest by three mornings' measurements, cool tanks above 28°C within four hours. Pending: lighter bottles (importer unconfirmed, no costing) and eastern replanting after 2027.
